data.one_liner: NineGridView and DragSortView for displaying images in a nine‑grid layout with drag‑and‑drop sorting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a grid view that arranges images in a nine‑cell layout similar to Weibo/WeChat. It also offers a drag‑and‑drop sortable view for selecting and ordering images.
use_when: Displaying a grid of images in a social‑media style feed
Implementing image selection with drag‑and‑drop sorting
avoid_when: Needing advanced animations or custom physics beyond the provided drag effect
Requiring null‑safety or extensive testing support
strengths: Supports multiple grid types (WeChat, Weibo, QQ group, DingTalk group)
Built‑in drag‑and‑drop sorting and delete gesture
weaknesses: Not migrated to null‑safety (v2.0.0 still TODO)
No unit or integration tests documented
